A '''skirmish''' occurred near [[Circarpous IV]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], between the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] performing barrier defense.

==The skirmish==
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> a three-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Flight group/Legends|flight group]] from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] launched a feint into the [[Circarpous system/Legends|Circaprous system]] to probe the system's [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] defenses. Near [[Circarpous IV]], three groups of three [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[TIE pilot|pilots]] from [[Alpha Squadron|Alpha]], [[Beta Squadron/Legends|Beta]], and [[Gamma Squadron/Legends|Gamma Squadrons]] engaged the [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]]. Despite being outnumbered three-to-one, the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] pilots destroyed all nine TIEs with no losses of their own.<ref name="Xwing" />

==Aftermath==
The Rebels' success in the face of unfavourable odds left an impression on the people of the Circarpous system.<ref name="Xwing" />

The engagement was later simulated as a training mission by the Rebel Alliance, intended to teach prospective pilots how to face a numerically superior enemy. [[Agamarian]] Rebel [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] was assigned to the simulation by [[Training officer/Legends|training officer]] [[Wex Dafid]] prior to Farlander's recruitment into the Alliance [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']]{{'s}} Red Squadron.<ref name="XWOSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared in the [[1993]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] as the fourth X-wing historical mission, "Beat The Odds."<ref name="Xwing" />
